title.zh: 修正的 fluidBW Maxwell 响应

summary: Evaluate determinant, dielectric K, Maxwell D and unchanged explicit state, with signed/zero-wavevector limits.

identity.definition: D=K+nnᵀ−n²I; fD/fDtensor finite symmetric harmonic cutoffs5/15 after analytic cancellation; fDR corrected full R with J8 approximation.
identity.model: static isotropic Maxwellian plasma or its declared numerical approximation
identity.geometry: uniform background B along z; wavevector (kx,0,kz)
identity.coordinates: Cartesian SI; exp(i k·x−i ωt); signed gyrofrequency and radius
identity.boundary: homogeneous linear response; explicit resonances and analytic removable limits
assumptions: Listed-species linear response; electron-only case2 does not establish global charge neutrality or a self-consistent background equilibrium.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Explicit isotropic Maxwellian SI state. S species; c2; signed wcs and rhocs; positive wps2 and vts; w and signed kz. Matrix assembly additionally requires epsilon0. rho=vts/(sqrt(2)*wcs).
inputs.units: c2 m²/s²; wcs,w rad/s; wps2 s^-2; rhocs m; vts m/s; kz m^-1; epsilon0 F/m
inputs.shape: mapping; species vectors length S; numeric arrays retain MATLAB shapes
inputs.constraints: Finite numeric fields and coherent thermal/gyro scales; metadata cannot override explicit controls.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: determinant, K[3x3], D[3x3] dimensionless; unchanged explicit state_after.
outputs.units: mixed SI and dimensionless as described
outputs.constraints: State and terminal diagnostics retain scientific meaning; no caller state mutation.

preconditions: Pinned Linux amd64 GNU Octave7.3.0 runtime; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
NumPy2.5.3 and SciPy1.18.1 Python3.12 scientific development runtime.
supported: Coherent SI state, complex kx, signed and zero kz; analytic nonresonant kx=0 limits.
Finite5/15 and full-harmonic J8 models, distinguished in output contract.
excluded: Genuine nonzero-residue cyclotron poles at zero kz; unmagnetized/zero-temperature/density/static-frequency limits.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for unknown controls, nonfinite/incoherent physical inputs, genuine poles or unrepresentable scientific response.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: RuntimeError for unsupported/missing native runtime or abnormal native exit; subprocess timeout is explicit.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No nonlinear search candidate semantics in this API. Precision/tail failures are explicit ValueError; EM eigen residual and insufficient-selection failures are explicit ValueError where applicable.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Errors return no result; no failed or partial execution is presented as a successful output.
